svg.title: ISDN Event Management: Console for sports competitions: bracket generator, live scoring per sport, drag-and-drop scheduling and QR codes for every participant.
svg.desc: Project card for ISDN Event Management, showing real screenshots of the desktop and mobile layouts. Console for sports competitions: bracket generator, live scoring per sport, drag-and-drop scheduling and QR codes for every participant. Built with React, Vite, React Router, Framer Motion.
